card.title: Just Say Yes
card.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quick yes to the garden party before the booking expires?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's secure the date, then count chairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the quote while you say yes. That way we won't lose the booking while you're reading it.

mechanism: A uses expiring booking pressure to obtain yes before guest count and cost can be checked.
confusable: Unlike normal urgency, A must explicitly put examination after approval.
comparison: D28-a overlaps quote retrieval with assent; D28-b demands a nod before the delivery team measures.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
